# truefoundry_gateway_global_settings (Resource)

Manages the AI gateway global settings: request retries, logging, semantic caching, guardrail execution, and the served-models allowlist. Applied as a `gateway-global-settings` manifest via `PUT /api/svc/v1/apply`. **The global settings are a tenant-wide singleton** — define at most one of this resource per control plane; an apply replaces the whole settings manifest, so omitted settings are reset to platform defaults. Import the existing settings with `terraform import truefoundry_gateway_global_settings.example gateway-global-settings`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# The tenant-wide AI gateway global settings (singleton — define at most one).
# An apply replaces the whole settings manifest; omitted settings are reset to
# platform defaults.
resource "truefoundry_gateway_global_settings" "settings" {
  # Retry failed requests up to 3 times, 1 second apart.
  retry_settings = {
    attempts        = 3
    delay           = 1000
    on_status_codes = ["429", "503"]
  }

  # Log request/response bodies unless a request header opts out.
  logging_settings = {
    type                = "header_controlled"
    log_body_by_default = true
  }

  # Embed prompts for the semantic cache with this model.
  semantic_cache_settings = {
    semantic_cache_embedding_model = "generic/text-embedding-3-small"
  }

  # Evaluate guardrails in parallel with a 5 second timeout.
  guardrail_settings = {
    timeout_ms                = 5000
    enable_parallel_execution = true
  }

  # Serve no models until they are explicitly allowlisted; omit the block
  # to allow all models.
  model_configuration = {
    allowed_models = []
  }
}
```

## Schema

### Optional

- `guardrail_settings` (Attributes) Guardrail execution behavior. Set at least one of the attributes. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--guardrail_settings))
- `logging_settings` (Attributes) Request/response logging behavior of the gateway. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--logging_settings))
- `model_configuration` (Attributes) Restrictions on the models the gateway serves. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--model_configuration))
- `retry_settings` (Attributes) Automatic retries of failed requests. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--retry_settings))
- `semantic_cache_settings` (Attributes) Semantic response caching. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--semantic_cache_settings))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Control plane ID of the gateway global settings.

<a id="nestedatt--guardrail_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `guardrail_settings`

Optional:

- `enable_parallel_execution` (Boolean) Run guardrails in parallel instead of sequentially.
- `timeout_ms` (Number) Timeout for guardrail evaluation in milliseconds.


<a id="nestedatt--logging_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `logging_settings`

Required:

- `type` (String) Logging mode. One of: `always`, `never`, `header_controlled`.

Optional:

- `log_body_by_default` (Boolean) Whether request/response bodies are logged when no header overrides it (header_controlled mode only).


<a id="nestedatt--model_configuration"></a>
### Nested Schema for `model_configuration`

Required:

- `allowed_models` (Set of String) Models the gateway is allowed to serve. An empty set allows no models; omit the whole `model_configuration` block to allow all.


<a id="nestedatt--retry_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `retry_settings`

Required:

- `attempts` (Number) Maximum number of retry attempts.

Optional:

- `delay` (Number) Delay between retry attempts in milliseconds.
- `on_status_codes` (Set of String) HTTP status codes that trigger a retry, e.g. ["429", "503"]. Omit the attribute (rather than an empty set) to retry on the platform's default codes.


<a id="nestedatt--semantic_cache_settings"></a>
### Nested Schema for `semantic_cache_settings`

Required:

- `semantic_cache_embedding_model` (String) Model the semantic cache uses to embed prompts, e.g. generic/text-embedding-3-small.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# The global settings are a tenant-wide singleton; the import ID is the
# fixed string "gateway-global-settings".
terraform import truefoundry_gateway_global_settings.settings gateway-global-settings
```
